verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly document LLM-as-a-judge evaluators, where a second model scores output against a rubric. They can be configured in the UI and attached to datasets, with automatic scoring and no code required. Judge models are swappable via adapters, explanations are returned by default, and SDKs give full control over evaluation logic and judge models. A community user also mentions using Phoenix evals. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of configuring custom judge rubrics/templates in depth.
